summary_1line: Krishna explains cosmic origins, divine names, Agni–Soma duality, Brahmin primacy, and myths including Dadhichi’s sacrifice, Indra’s fall, and Nahusha’s rise.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Dadhichi peacefully relinquishes his body in meditation as the gods gather to forge Indra’s thunderbolt from his bones.
Indra, shrunken by yogic power, hides within the fibers of a lotus stalk in the serene waters of Lake Manasa.
At the dawn of creation, an endless dark ocean fills the universe as the formless Narayana arises from primordial Tamas.
